source.name: Sport1.pl: Orlen zostaje z Kubicą. AF Corse pokazało Ferrari 499P
source.quote: Na karoserii ponownie nie zabrakło logotypów Orlenu, co potwierdza kontynuację współpracy z Robertem Kubicą w wyścigach długodystansowych.
source.note: Polish quote translates as: 'Orlen logos again feature on the bodywork of AF Corse's 2026 WEC Ferrari 499P, confirming the continuation of the partnership with Robert Kubica.'

source.name: ESA NanoTech: ESA NanoTech scende in pista con AF Corse: siglata la partnership per la partecipazione nel FIA World Endurance Championship
source.quote: Il logo ESA NanoTech trova spazio sulla sezione laterale e sul frontale della vettura, integrandosi nella livrea gialla e rossa
source.note: Italian quote translates as: 'The ESA NanoTech logo is placed on the side section and the front of the car, integrated into the yellow and red livery.' New technical and commercial partnership with AF Corse for the 2026 WEC season, announced by the sponsor itself.

summary: 2026 WEC livery of AF Corse's privateer #83 Ferrari 499P: Orlen logos on the bodywork (confirmed by sport1.pl at the livery reveal) and ESA NanoTech on the side section and front (announced by the sponsor itself). sponsorsComplete is false: not every small decal on the car could be verified, and the drivers' race suits are not documented in any opened source.
